name: Classical (Newtonian/Lagrangian/Hamiltonian) Mechanics
domain: mechanics of point particles and rigid bodies at low speed
lawful_layer_description: Deterministic dynamics on phase space; states are points (q,p), evolution by Hamilton's/Newton's equations. A lawful closed layer for slow, heavy, macroscopic bodies far below c and far above hbar action scales. Self-consistent, predictive, no internal obstruction in its regime.
provisional_Z: phase-space points (q,p) in T*Q; trajectories as solutions of ODEs on a symplectic manifold
provisional_f: lens = configuration/phase coordinates; coarse description retains positions, momenta, conserved charges (energy, momentum, angular momentum)
provisional_E: completion = symplectic/Hamiltonian flow; idempotent under time-evolution closure; canonical transformations preserve the bracket structure
accepted_observables: positions, velocities, momenta, energy, period, trajectory, conserved quantities, action
notes: Within-layer this is textbook analytical mechanics; SBT adds nothing here (primer s3). Card is a faithful description, not a reduction. Sits as a shadow-target of QM (decoherence/Ehrenfest) and SR (c->inf limit) -- those are EDGES for drafter 4, not stated here.

name: Newtonian Gravity
domain: gravitation in the weak-field, slow-motion regime
lawful_layer_description: Instantaneous 1/r^2 universal attraction; gravitational potential satisfies Poisson's equation. A lawful closed layer for planetary/laboratory gravity where fields are weak and velocities << c. Predictive and self-consistent in regime; Mercury-perihelion-scale residuals mark its boundary.
provisional_Z: mass distributions rho(x) and the scalar potential Phi(x); test-particle trajectories
provisional_f: lens = Newtonian potential field and gravitational acceleration g = -grad Phi
provisional_E: completion = solving Poisson's equation laplacian(Phi)=4 pi G rho with boundary conditions; superposition closure
accepted_observables: orbital periods, Kepler elements, gravitational acceleration, tidal forces, escape velocity
notes: Distinct layer from classical mechanics (specifies the force law) and a recognized weak-field shadow-target of GR. The G in 1/r^2 is an empirical input here, not derived -- flagged so no edge later 'derives' it.

name: Special Relativity
domain: kinematics and dynamics in flat spacetime at any speed below c
lawful_layer_description: Minkowski spacetime with Lorentz invariance; no preferred frame; c is the invariant speed. A lawful closed layer for inertial-frame physics absent gravity. Self-consistent; reduces in appearance to Galilean kinematics only as a low-v shadow (an edge, not internal content).
provisional_Z: events in Minkowski space R^{1,3}; four-vectors (x^mu, p^mu); worldlines
provisional_f: lens = Lorentz-invariant structure: the metric eta_{mu nu}, proper time, invariant interval, four-momentum
provisional_E: completion = Poincare-covariant kinematics/dynamics; closure under Lorentz boosts and translations
accepted_observables: time dilation, length contraction, relativistic energy-momentum E^2=(pc)^2+(mc^2)^2, invariant mass, velocity addition, Doppler shift
notes: c is a postulated invariant, not derived. Galilean limit (c->inf) is a calibration-grade descent edge for drafter 4.

name: General Relativity
domain: gravitation as spacetime curvature; classical, all field strengths
lawful_layer_description: Dynamical Lorentzian spacetime; matter curves geometry via Einstein's field equations; free fall = geodesic motion. A lawful closed CLASSICAL layer (no quantization). Self-consistent; singularity theorems mark where the layer's own assumptions break (an internal flag, not a reduction).
provisional_Z: Lorentzian 4-manifolds (M, g_{mu nu}) with stress-energy T_{mu nu}; geodesics
provisional_f: lens = spacetime metric and its curvature (Riemann, Ricci, Einstein tensors); causal structure
provisional_E: completion = solving Einstein's equations G_{mu nu}+Lambda g_{mu nu}=8 pi G/c^4 T_{mu nu}; diffeomorphism-covariant closure
accepted_observables: perihelion precession, light bending, gravitational redshift, Shapiro delay, gravitational waves, frame dragging, black-hole horizons
notes: Newtonian-gravity weak-field limit is a recognized descent (calibration-adjacent). The QM<->GR boundary (quantum gravity) is a HARD/FORECLOSED edge for drafter 4 -- not resolved here. Lambda appears as a layer parameter; its value is NOT derived in this card.

name: Non-relativistic Quantum Mechanics
domain: microscopic dynamics of fixed particle number at low energy
lawful_layer_description: States are rays/density operators on a Hilbert space; unitary Schrodinger evolution plus the Born rule for measurement statistics. A lawful closed layer for atoms, molecules, non-relativistic many-body systems. Self-consistent and spectacularly predictive in regime; the measurement/classical-emergence question is an inter-layer EDGE, not an internal defect.
provisional_Z: vectors in (or density operators on) a separable Hilbert space H; wavefunctions psi(x,t)
provisional_f: lens = quantum state and its expectation values; observables as self-adjoint operators; the algebra of observables
provisional_E: completion = unitary evolution exp(-iHt/hbar) plus Born-rule packaging of measurement outcomes; closure under composition (tensor products)
accepted_observables: energy spectra, transition probabilities, expectation values, interference/diffraction patterns, tunneling rates, entanglement correlations
notes: Classical mechanics is a decoherence/Ehrenfest shadow-target (an edge). hbar is a layer constant, not derived. Do NOT score SBT within this layer (primer s3 trap 4).

name: Relativistic Quantum Field Theory (general framework)
domain: quantum fields in flat spacetime; relativistic, variable particle number
lawful_layer_description: Marries QM and SR: local quantum fields, Poincare invariance, microcausality, particle creation/annihilation. A lawful framework-layer (Wightman/path-integral/algebraic formulations) within which specific models (QED, QCD, ...) are instances. Predictive where renormalizable/EFT-controlled; defined with a regulator/cutoff whose removal is the layer's own technical content.
provisional_Z: operator-valued distributions (quantum fields) on Minkowski space; Fock/representation spaces; or lattice-regularized path-integral configurations
provisional_f: lens = correlation functions / S-matrix; Poincare-covariant, microcausal local observables
provisional_E: completion = path-integral or operator quantization with renormalization; closure under the renormalization group and operator-product expansion
accepted_observables: scattering cross sections, S-matrix amplitudes, decay rates, correlation/Green's functions, anomalous dimensions
notes: Framework layer; the EFT/RG relation to its low-energy descendants is a recognized descent-family (edges). Rigorous existence of interacting 4D QFT is an open math problem -- noted, not claimed solved.

name: Quantum Electrodynamics
domain: electromagnetic interactions of charged leptons and photons
lawful_layer_description: The QFT of the electron/positron (and other charged leptons) coupled to the photon via a U(1) gauge field. A lawful closed layer; the most precisely tested theory in physics. Self-consistent as a renormalizable QFT / well-defined EFT below its Landau scale.
provisional_Z: Dirac fermion fields + U(1) gauge field A_mu; perturbative Feynman-diagram configurations or lattice-QED path integrals
provisional_f: lens = U(1)-gauge-invariant correlators, S-matrix; coupling alpha at a scale
provisional_E: completion = renormalized perturbation theory in alpha (plus nonperturbative path integral); RG closure
accepted_observables: electron/muon anomalous magnetic moment (g-2), Lamb shift, hydrogen spectrum fine structure, scattering cross sections, running of alpha
notes: An instance of relativistic_qft and a sector of the electroweak/Standard-Model layer (those overlaps are edges). Geometrical optics is a far-downstream classical shadow (via classical EM) -- an edge, not here. alpha is a measured input.

name: Quantum Chromodynamics
domain: strong interaction of quarks and gluons
lawful_layer_description: Non-abelian SU(3)-color gauge QFT; asymptotically free at high energy, confining and chiral-symmetry-breaking at low energy. A lawful closed layer. Under the declared physical-quark-mass lattice-QCD protocol there is no free proton/hadron MASS parameter: quark masses and the coupling/scale are fixed independently (the scale set by one hadronic input, the running by dimensional transmutation, Lambda_QCD), and the low-energy hadron spectrum is then an out-of-sample readout accessible only by RUNNING the lattice path integral. This is the canonical E0 / run-only anchor for the whole atlas.
provisional_Z: quark (Dirac, color-triplet) fields + SU(3) gluon gauge fields; lattice gauge-field configurations on a discretized spacetime
provisional_f: lens = color-singlet gauge-invariant correlators (Wilson loops, hadron interpolators); the strong coupling alpha_s at a scale
provisional_E: completion = the regularized gauge-field path integral; RG closure with asymptotic freedom; nonperturbative confinement
accepted_observables: hadron mass spectrum (proton, pion, ...), confinement/string tension, chiral condensate, running of alpha_s, deep-inelastic structure functions
notes: CALIBRATION ANCHOR. QCD -> hadron masses is the worked E0 edge (drafter 4): the proton mass has no closed-form derivation; it is the readout of an irreducible lattice run (primer s5, digest). PRECISE CALIBRATION WORDING (review fix R8, = CONTRACT calibration_rules E001): this is PHYSICAL-QUARK-MASS lattice QCD (not the chiral limit, not pure-gauge); there is NO free proton/hadron MASS parameter; the quark masses and the coupling/scale are fixed INDEPENDENTLY under the declared lattice-QCD protocol (the overall scale set by ONE hadronic input, the running by dimensional transmutation / Lambda_QCD); the proton-mass / hadron-spectrum readout is then OUT-OF-SAMPLE and NOT fitted. Nothing here 'derives' the proton mass. Deferred to the Run-Target Manifest; NOT run, NOT derived. THE anchor.

name: Electroweak (Glashow-Salam-Weinberg) Theory
domain: unified electromagnetic and weak interactions
lawful_layer_description: SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y gauge QFT with Higgs spontaneous symmetry breaking giving masses to W/Z and fermions while leaving the photon massless. A lawful closed layer / sector of the Standard Model. Renormalizable, predictive, experimentally confirmed (W, Z, Higgs).
provisional_Z: SU(2)_L doublet + U(1)_Y fermion fields, SU(2)xU(1) gauge fields, the complex Higgs doublet; path-integral configurations
provisional_f: lens = gauge-invariant electroweak correlators/S-matrix; the Weinberg angle, gauge couplings, vev
provisional_E: completion = Higgs-mechanism symmetry breaking + renormalized perturbation theory; RG closure
accepted_observables: W/Z masses and widths, Weinberg mixing angle, Higgs mass and couplings, parity violation, neutral-current rates, muon decay
notes: QED emerges as the unbroken-U(1)_em sub-sector below EWSB (an edge). The Higgs vev and Yukawa couplings (hence fermion masses) are measured inputs -- the mass hierarchy / 3-generations puzzle is a HARD edge for drafter 4, NOT explained here.

name: The Standard Model of Particle Physics
domain: all known non-gravitational particle interactions
lawful_layer_description: The full SU(3)_C x SU(2)_L x U(1)_Y gauge QFT: QCD + electroweak, three fermion generations, the Higgs. A lawful closed layer (as a renormalizable QFT / EFT valid up to a high cutoff). Comprehensive and confirmed; its parameter values (gauge group choice, ~19+ free parameters, generation structure) are inputs, not consequences.
provisional_Z: the full SM field content (quarks, leptons, gauge bosons, Higgs) and their path-integral configurations
provisional_f: lens = full set of gauge-invariant correlators/S-matrix; the ~19 SM parameters at a reference scale
provisional_E: completion = renormalized QFT with the SM Lagrangian; RG running of all couplings; EFT closure below the cutoff
accepted_observables: all measured particle masses/mixings (CKM, PMNS), cross sections, decay rates, precision electroweak observables, Higgs sector
notes: Contains qcd and electroweak_theory as sectors (overlaps are edges). The GAUGE-GROUP ORIGIN, THREE GENERATIONS, and MASS HIERARCHY are explicitly HARD/EMBARRASSING edges (drafter 4) -- the SM does not explain its own structure; the atlas must NOT pretend SBT derives it.

name: Classical Thermodynamics
domain: macroscopic energy/entropy bookkeeping of equilibrium matter
lawful_layer_description: The phenomenological layer of state variables (T, P, V, S, U, ...) and the four laws. A lawful closed layer with NO reference to microscopic constituents -- it is autonomous. Self-consistent and universal; statistical mechanics provides a recognized shadow/grounding (an edge), but thermodynamics stands as its own lawful theory.
provisional_Z: equilibrium macrostates as points in a thermodynamic state space (extensive/intensive variables)
provisional_f: lens = state functions (internal energy, entropy, free energies) and equations of state
provisional_E: completion = Legendre-transform structure + the laws (esp. 2nd law: dS>=0) as closure conditions; quasi-static-process closure
accepted_observables: temperature, pressure, entropy, heat capacities, latent heats, efficiency bounds (Carnot), phase-coexistence curves
notes: stat-mech -> thermodynamics is a CALIBRATION descent edge (known E1, drafter 4). Thermodynamics is autonomous: do not 'reduce' it to stat mech here -- the relation is a shadow, audited as an edge. GR<->thermodynamics (horizon thermodynamics) is a separate recognition-conditional edge.

name: Statistical Mechanics
domain: microscopic ensembles underlying macroscopic equilibrium/near-equilibrium matter
lawful_layer_description: Probability distributions over microstates (Gibbs ensembles); partition functions; the bridge Boltzmann relation S=k_B ln(Omega). A lawful closed layer connecting microphysics to thermodynamic potentials. Self-consistent and predictive; equilibrium ensemble theory is on firm footing (ergodicity/foundations have open corners, noted not hidden).
provisional_Z: microstates of a many-body system + probability measures (microcanonical/canonical/grand-canonical ensembles)
provisional_f: lens = ensemble-averaged quantities; partition function Z and free energy -k_B T ln Z; correlation functions
provisional_E: completion = ensemble construction + thermodynamic limit (N->inf); closure under the maximum-entropy/Gibbs measure
accepted_observables: partition functions, free energies, specific heats, fluctuation-response (susceptibilities), critical exponents, equations of state
notes: Source layer of the canonical E1 descent to thermodynamics (calibration). k_B is a unit-conversion constant. Critical phenomena/RG connect this layer to its own coarse-grainings (edges).

name: Kinetic Theory (Boltzmann transport)
domain: dilute-gas dynamics via single-particle distribution functions
lawful_layer_description: The Boltzmann equation governs the one-particle phase-space distribution f(x,v,t) with a collision integral; the H-theorem gives entropy increase. A lawful closed mesoscopic layer between microscopic dynamics and hydrodynamics. Self-consistent under the dilute-gas / molecular-chaos (Stosszahlansatz) assumption -- which is the layer's stated closure premise, not a hidden fudge.
provisional_Z: single-particle distribution functions f(x,v,t) on mu-space; collision configurations
provisional_f: lens = the distribution function and its velocity moments (density, momentum, energy fluxes)
provisional_E: completion = Boltzmann transport equation with the collision integral; molecular-chaos closure; relaxation toward local Maxwellian
accepted_observables: transport coefficients (viscosity, thermal conductivity, diffusion), mean free path, relaxation times, H-function/entropy production
notes: kinetic -> hydrodynamics (Chapman-Enskog / Navier-Stokes recovery) is a recognized descent edge (E1-control candidate, drafter 4). The molecular-chaos assumption is the named closure premise; flagged so an edge does not over-read it.

name: Hydrodynamics / Navier-Stokes
domain: continuum flow of fluids
lawful_layer_description: Continuum fields (density, velocity, pressure, temperature) obeying conservation laws closed by constitutive relations (Newtonian stress, Fourier heat). A lawful closed macroscopic layer for fluids at small Knudsen number. Self-consistent in regime; turbulence and global Navier-Stokes regularity are open WITHIN-layer problems (noted, not a reduction question).
provisional_Z: continuum fields rho(x,t), u(x,t), p, T on a flow domain; solutions of the NS/Euler PDEs
provisional_f: lens = coarse hydrodynamic fields (the slow/conserved modes) and their gradients
provisional_E: completion = conservation laws (mass, momentum, energy) + constitutive closure (viscosity, conductivity); gradient-expansion closure at small Knudsen number
accepted_observables: flow velocity/pressure fields, drag, lift, sound speed, vortex dynamics, Reynolds-number-dependent regimes, dispersion relations
notes: Recognized descent-target of kinetic_theory (constitutive coefficients supplied from below) -- an edge, E1-control candidate. Navier-Stokes existence/smoothness is an intra-layer open problem, NOT an inter-layer SBT question; flagged to prevent miscasting.

name: Condensed Matter / Symmetry-Protected Topological Phases
domain: collective phases of many-body quantum matter
lawful_layer_description: Emergent low-energy effective theories of interacting many-body systems: quasiparticles, order parameters, topological order, SPT/SET phases classified by group cohomology / cobordism. A lawful closed layer (or family of layers) whose objects (e.g. anyons, edge modes, fractional charge) are genuinely NEW relative to the microscopic constituent description -- a textbook case of physics-recognized emergence.
provisional_Z: many-body ground states / low-energy effective field theories (e.g. Chern-Simons, sigma models); lattice Hamiltonian ground states
provisional_f: lens = order parameters, topological invariants (Chern number, group-cohomology class), emergent gauge structure, edge spectra
provisional_E: completion = low-energy/long-wavelength effective theory + topological classification; RG-fixed-point closure
accepted_observables: quantized Hall conductance, fractional charge/statistics, protected edge modes, ground-state degeneracy, topological entanglement entropy
notes: A leading candidate site for genuine UPWARD emergence edges (non-definable-from-below collective objects; non-factorization in the primer's sense). Provisional only -- drafter 4 audits each such edge; emergence claims must be FORCED, not asserted. SPT classification (group cohomology) is the structured math content here.

name: Lambda-CDM Cosmology
domain: large-scale structure and evolution of the universe
lawful_layer_description: The standard cosmological model: a homogeneous/isotropic FLRW spacetime (GR-based) with cold dark matter + a cosmological constant Lambda, plus baryons, radiation, and a primordial fluctuation spectrum. A lawful closed layer fitting precision data with ~6 parameters. Predictive and confirmed across many observables; the NATURE of dark matter and the VALUE of Lambda are inputs/open, not consequences.
provisional_Z: FLRW metric + perturbations; the cosmic fluid (CDM, baryons, radiation, Lambda) energy budget; mode amplitudes
provisional_f: lens = scale factor a(t), Hubble rate, density parameters Omega_i, the matter/CMB power spectra
provisional_E: completion = Friedmann equations + linear perturbation theory + Boltzmann/transfer-function evolution; statistical closure of the fluctuation field
accepted_observables: CMB anisotropy spectrum, BAO scale, supernova distance-redshift relation, large-scale structure power spectrum, primordial abundances (BBN)
notes: Built on general_relativity (cosmology as a GR application). The COSMOLOGICAL CONSTANT problem (Lambda value, ~120 orders of magnitude) is an explicitly HARD/EMBARRASSING edge for drafter 4 -- the atlas must NOT pretend SBT derives Lambda. Dark-matter identity is open.

name: Black-Hole Thermodynamics
domain: thermodynamic laws of gravitational horizons
lawful_layer_description: Black holes obey laws formally identical to thermodynamics: horizon area ~ entropy (Bekenstein-Hawking S=A/4G), surface gravity ~ temperature (Hawking radiation), with a first law dM = (kappa/8 pi) dA + .... A lawful closed semiclassical layer (QFT on a fixed curved background). Self-consistent at the semiclassical level; the information-paradox / microscopic-state-counting question is a recognized open frontier, NOT settled here.
provisional_Z: stationary black-hole spacetimes + quantum fields on the fixed background; horizon data (area, surface gravity, charges)
provisional_f: lens = horizon thermodynamic variables (area/entropy, surface gravity/temperature, mass, charge, angular momentum)
provisional_E: completion = the four laws of black-hole mechanics + Hawking-radiation semiclassical packaging; first-law closure
accepted_observables: Hawking temperature, Bekenstein-Hawking entropy, horizon area-increase, evaporation spectrum/rate (theoretical), first-law relations
notes: Sits at a RECOGNITION-CONDITIONAL junction of general_relativity, qft, and thermodynamics. GR<->thermodynamics and gravity<->entanglement are E2-style recognition edges for drafter 4 (land only by importing a named principle, e.g. holography). Semiclassical: not a quantum-gravity theory. No microscopic entropy derivation claimed.

name: Classical Electromagnetism (Maxwell)
domain: classical electric, magnetic, and radiation phenomena
lawful_layer_description: Maxwell's equations for the E and B fields sourced by charges/currents; relativistically covariant; light as electromagnetic waves. A lawful closed classical field-theory layer. Self-consistent and complete in its regime (macroscopic fields, no quantum/strong-field corrections).
provisional_Z: the electromagnetic field (E,B) or four-potential A_mu over spacetime; charge/current distributions; field configurations
provisional_f: lens = the EM field tensor F_{mu nu} and gauge-invariant field quantities; the wave/radiation modes
provisional_E: completion = solving Maxwell's equations with sources and boundary conditions; superposition + gauge-fixing closure
accepted_observables: field strengths, forces on charges (Lorentz force), radiation patterns, wave propagation/polarization, impedance, refraction/reflection
notes: Included to anchor the geometrical-optics shadow edge (eikonal/short-wavelength limit -> geometrical_optics) and as the classical limit of QED (an edge). Already SR-covariant, so the SR relation is structural, not a separate descent.

name: Geometrical (Ray) Optics
domain: light propagation in the short-wavelength limit
lawful_layer_description: Light as rays obeying Fermat's principle / the eikonal equation; reflection, refraction, imaging, caustics. A lawful closed layer valid when wavelengths are small compared with system scales. Self-consistent in regime; breaks (diffraction, interference) exactly mark its boundary -- a clean textbook example of a coarse-grained shadow layer.
provisional_Z: rays as trajectories / the eikonal (phase) function S(x); wavefront surfaces
provisional_f: lens = ray paths, the eikonal/optical path length, ray directions (grad S)
provisional_E: completion = Fermat/eikonal extremal-path construction; ray-tracing closure (Hamiltonian optics)
accepted_observables: image locations/magnification, focal lengths, refraction angles (Snell), aberrations, caustic surfaces
notes: CLEAN E1 descent control: geometrical optics is the lambda->0 / WKB shadow of classical_electromagnetism (wave optics). Included precisely because it is a TRANSPARENT, checkable coarse-graining -- a fair, non-flattering known E1 edge for the calibration set.

name: Brownian Motion / Langevin-Fokker-Planck Stochastic Dynamics
domain: stochastic dynamics of mesoscopic particles in a thermal bath
lawful_layer_description: A coarse-grained stochastic layer: a heavy particle's motion under random + dissipative forces (Langevin equation), equivalently the Fokker-Planck/Smoluchowski PDE for its probability density, with fluctuation-dissipation tying noise to friction and temperature. A lawful closed mesoscopic layer. Self-consistent given the bath/Markov closure assumptions (its stated premises).
provisional_Z: stochastic trajectories X(t) (Langevin) and/or probability densities P(x,t) (Fokker-Planck); noise realizations
provisional_f: lens = the probability density and its moments; drift and diffusion coefficients; correlation functions
provisional_E: completion = the Langevin SDE / Fokker-Planck operator with fluctuation-dissipation closure; Markovian coarse-graining
accepted_observables: mean-square displacement, diffusion coefficient, friction/mobility, first-passage times, stationary (Boltzmann) distribution, Einstein relation
notes: Included as an honest extra: a textbook downward-shadow / coarse-graining (microscopic Hamiltonian bath -> Langevin) with a recognized fluctuation-dissipation grounding. Useful E1-style descent test material; fluctuation-dissipation is the named closure premise.

name: Renormalization Group / Effective Field Theory (as a layer-generating principle)
domain: the scale-organization of physical theories
lawful_layer_description: RG/EFT is the meta-structure by which physics ITSELF organizes theories by scale: integrate out short-distance modes, flow couplings, and obtain an effective layer valid below a cutoff, organized by relevance/irrelevance of operators. Not a single phenomenological theory but the physics-internal machinery of inter-scale descent. Lawful and rigorous as a calculational/organizational framework.
provisional_Z: the space of effective Lagrangians/actions (theory space); couplings as coordinates; RG trajectories
provisional_f: lens = the relevant/marginal couplings at a given scale; fixed points; scaling dimensions
provisional_E: completion = the RG flow (Wilsonian mode-elimination) toward fixed points / effective actions; universality-class closure
accepted_observables: critical exponents, universality classes, running couplings, matching coefficients, anomalous dimensions, beta functions
notes: META-ENTRY (flagged): RG/EFT is the physics-native analogue of SBT's own lens/coarse-graining/descent move -- the single most important honest comparator. Many 'shadow down' edges in this atlas ARE RG/EFT descents; included so the atlas does not claim as novel SBT-content what physics already does as RG. This is the primer's 'textbook in costume' guardrail made explicit.
